title: Player Bank
description: A unique player storage plugin for your server
body:
**The plugin allows players to store their items in a storage space. This storage space can be expanded using server currency or coinsengine currency.**

- **The plugin allows players to store their items. Storage can be expanded using server or CoinsEngine currency.**

- **Vault required for work**
- CoinsEngine is optional

**Plugin languages: English, Russian, Ukrainian, Spanish, French**
- The plugin's main settings are in config.yml.

**Commands for players:**
/bank - Opens the storage menu.

- **Commands for admins:**
- /abank see <nickname> - View player storage
- /abank edit <nickname> - Edit player storage.
- /abank clear <nickname> - Clear player storage
- /abank delete <nickname> - Delete a player's storage.

**Admin rights:**
- bank.admin — perform all admin actions
- bank.admin.delete — Delete player storage
- bank.admin.clear: Clear player storage.
- bank.admin.see: view player storage
- bank.admin.edit: Edit player storage
- bank.admin.reload: Reload configuration.

**Player rights:**
- bank.use: Use the bank (default for all).
- Bank.Buy: All purchases (parental right).
- bank.buy.cell: Purchase one cell.
- bank.buy.row: Purchase a row (9 cells).
- Bank.Buy.Page: Purchase a page (36 cells).

**If you encounter a bug or notice that something isn't working properly, change debug to true in config.yml file. Then send the information from the console to me in discord altov1337.**
